# Full Rust interactive slash-command matrix.
# Rows are command|visible-substring|follow-up. A follow-up of "escape"
# closes a selector modal; "enter" confirms the default selector choice; "clear"
# uses a seeded prompt before asserting that the transcript was cleared.
/settings|Default thinking level|escape
/model|faux/Faux Model|escape
/thinking|low|escape
/theme|dark|escape
/session|session |
/compact|nothing to compact
/hotkeys|hotkeys: enter submit
/help|commands: /settings /model /thinking
/copy|no assistant message to copy
/clear|__clear_transcript__|clear
/trust allow|default project trust: allow
/trust maybe|usage: /trust <allow|deny|ask>
/reload|reloaded settings
/share|share skipped
/login faux|no OAuth login available
/logout|usage: /logout <provider>
/logout faux|logged out faux
/name matrix fixture|session name: matrix fixture
/name|usage: /name <session-name>
/resume|no sessions found to resume in this directory
/tree|session tree:
/fork|fork session|enter-clear
/clone|Nothing to clone yet
/new|started new session
/export $HTML|exported session to
/import $IMPORT|imported
/import $MISSING|file not found: $MISSING
